list.title: Top Automotive OEM — ¥8M Contract
list.client: A global TOP 5 automotive manufacturer (annual output >1 million vehicles), with factories across 12 countries on 4 continents.
list.challenge: Over 500 critical lubrication points across stamping, welding, painting and assembly workshops. The traditional series lubrication system frequently experienced single-point failures causing full production line shutdowns, with average annual unplanned downtime of 120 hours and production losses exceeding ¥2M.
solution: Deployed DDS-800 direct-drive multi-point system with independent control for all 500+ lubrication points
MJS06 smart flow sensors + MJV06 vibration monitoring modules for real-time multi-dimensional data acquisition
LubeCloud platform integrated with client MES system for synchronized production-lubrication scheduling
3-person on-site technical support team with 24/7 response
list.quote: We used to have emergency line shutdowns every month due to lubrication failures. Now it's been half a year with zero faults. We finally don't have to worry about lubrication anymore.

list.title: Food Processing Leader — ¥6M Contract
list.client: A nationally recognized agricultural industrialization leader with annual revenue exceeding ¥5 billion, exporting products to over 30 countries and regions.
list.challenge: HACCP/ISO22000 food safety system demands extremely strict lubrication control. Traditional lubrication methods could not precisely meter food-grade lubricant, creating contamination risks from over-lubrication and resulting in a product pass rate of only 97.2%.
solution: Full production line digital lubrication retrofit covering filling, sealing, and packaging critical stations
P02 micro-flow metering cartridge delivering 0.02mL/min precision lubrication, eliminating over-lubrication
Fully sealed IP67 design meeting cleanroom hygiene requirements
Complete data logging per lubrication point enabling full-chain traceability from raw materials to finished products
list.quote: Our quality control team used to spend every day spot-checking lubrication points. Now the system handles it automatically, and we can breathe easy. Quality management has taken a major leap forward.

list.title: Pharma GMP Compliance — FDA Zero Defects
list.titleEn: Pharma GMP Compliance — FDA Zero Defects
list.client: A leading pharmaceutical enterprise with global product distribution, subject to regular FDA/EMA on-site inspections.
list.challenge: Strict GMP compliance requirements (21 CFR Part 11). Equipment OEE at only 72% — below industry average. Frequent lubrication-related deviation events triggering CAPA processes, consuming significant manpower annually for audit documentation.
solution: Complete GMP compliance package: IQ/OQ/PQ validation documentation + electronic signatures + audit trails
High-precision temperature control (±0.1°C) with real-time environmental monitoring
CSV (Computerized System Validation) fully compliant with FDA 21 CFR Part 11
LubeAnalytics data engine for automated compliance report generation
list.quote: With complete electronic signatures and audit trails, we now handle every FDA inspection with confidence. The compliance burden has been dramatically reduced.
